scenarios.name: normal_heating_ventilation
scenarios.description: Reference vector: OAF 0.148 with the heating valve at 50% (oat −5 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 18 °C) — at design minimum, no excess

scenarios.name: excess_oa_while_heating
scenarios.description: Reference vector: OAF 0.444 with the heating valve at 80% (oat −5 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 10 °C); alarms after alarm_delay (1800 s)

scenarios.name: small_delta_not_evaluable
scenarios.description: Reference vector: |oat − rat| = 2 °C (oat 20 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 21 °C, valve 20%) — the raw fraction reads 0.50, so an ungated rule would alarm; yTempDeltaOk stays false and holds yFault down

scenarios.name: valve_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: heating valve sits exactly at valve_open_threshold (5%) with OAF 0.444 — the strict `>` means the coil does not count as heating

scenarios.name: margin_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: OAF 0.30 exactly (oat 2 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 16 °C), so the margin equals oa_excess_margin — the strict `>` means no fault

scenarios.name: margin_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: OAF 0.31 (mat 15.8 °C) clears the strict comparison and alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: valve_closes_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: OAF stays at 0.444 but the heating valve closes at t=1200 — 1200 s of heating, short of alarm_delay, so no alarm
